mainText: Hello, Verona! At 4 PM, here is today's balanced dish: it is 67 degrees with clear skies at Badger Prairie County Park, with a moderate air quality index of 71 and a waxing gibbous moon.

The Mark Drive reconstruction project continues with Phase 2 progress, including completed utility work and ongoing concrete installation on Mark Drive and Todd Street, while the Verona Senior Center remains active with travel opportunities and services for residents 55 and older.
We have a busy schedule of local fun starting with Hop Haus Trivia today at 6:30 PM, followed by tomorrow's events including Yoga at Insight Wellness and trivia at The Bogey Factory.
In our weekly report, the Verona Police Department arrested a school bus driver on October 15 for O W I, noting that no injuries were reported and the investigation is ongoing.
Today is the perfect day to stop by for our flavor of the day, Devil's Food Cake, and since the store is open until 10:00 PM, you have plenty of time to head out and enjoy a scoop.
